notes.title: Lot's of News!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Shadow You is participating Indie Live Expo Winter Steam Sales, and having a 35% off discount until November 13th.

We also have news on the Nintendo Switch version. Although we don't have a fixed release date yet, but it won't be long!

Thank you very much for your continous support!

notes.title: The Shadow You Now Supports Customized VO and many fixes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Today we pushed our first update for The Shadow You! The game now supports adding player-customized voiceover for dialogs via Steam Workshop. In addition, we added Russian Voice Acting to the game (optional for download) and fixed some bugs.

To celebrate this update, we'll have a week-long discount starting from PST Mar 15, 2021 10:00am to PST Mar 22, 2021 10:00am.

We hope you could enjoy this update, and please let us hear your feedbacks!


Cheers!

notes.title: The Shadow You is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Shadow You is now live on Steam!  The game is a visual novel combined with an adventure game in which the player takes control of the main characters – one at a time depending on the part of the story – and interacts with various locations, items and other characters, chooses dialog options and solves puzzles.

We are super happy that we've finally made it! We hope you like it. 

Enjoy!
